text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My first three years in the Twinkle Series
with
Tamamo Cross have come to an
end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a solid career, our efforts paid off
in an
offer neither of us could have seen
coming.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Did I hear ya right? A manga?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And they wanna make me the main character... You jerkin' my chain here?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A manga... Me, in a manga... An actual
manga
with me in it...
choice_data_list: ああ、オファーが来たんだ
うん、オファーが来たの

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I never woulda imagined this for myself.
But...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The li'l squirts back home might like it. I
can see
'em now, waltzin' 'round the
neighborhood,
braggin' about their big
sis...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I bet they'd be proud of me. With all the

attention, I'd practically be a star.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Just... it's kinda embarrassin' thinkin'
about it...
Me showin' up in a manga.
What should I do
here?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Then why didn'tcha lead with
that?!
choice_data_list: 家計の足しにもなりそうだけど？
choice_data_list_en: Wouldn't that help out with household expenses, though?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... And if I get even more people
talkin' 'bout
me, I'd get more royalties in
my pocket...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that settles it. I accept! Which
means that
startin' now, in all the races I
got comin' up...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I gotta run my butt off!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why are ya lookin' at me like I said

somethin' crazy?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. C'mon, let's hold a
meetin'...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama! Trainer! Listen to this!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's goin' on, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be the protagonist in a
manga.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wh-what the—you too? I mean, coincidences do happen...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Geez, we sure are popular...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That brings me to my request. Tama, I
want you
to be in my manga.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It'll be boring without you showing up. I
can't
even imagine it without you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You want me in the Oguri manga, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me. But I sure hope ya know
what you're
in for, comin' to me with that
kinda offer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: This could cost ya, big time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What?! No! I mean that if I'm gonna be
in Oguri's
manga, I'm stealin' da show.
choice_data_list: まさか……そっちも家計の足しに？
choice_data_list_en: Don't tell me... that's to help with the family finances too?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri! I'm about to put ya on a losin' streak a mile long! That story of yours is gonna go my way.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So if ya wanna keep the lead role in your
own
manga, ya better come at me like
ya mean it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...You got it, Tama!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the two head off to the
training
grounds together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems White Lightning's popularity
can't be
contained to the real world, and
soon her exploits
will line the shelves of
countless bookstores.
